title: FlashVSR+: Efficient Video Super-Resolution via Hybrid Attention and Reward-Yield Distribution Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.17552v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent video super-resolution (VSR) models achieve efficient one-step generation through diffusion distillation. However, high-resolution inference remains costly, and distilled models are difficult to align with human preferences. These challenges call for improvements in both model architecture and training strategy. We present \textbf{FlashVSR+} to address both limitations. On the architecture side, we introduce hybrid attention based on the strong locality observed in pretrained VSR models, while retaining sparse global interaction for long-range consistency. It achieves up to $2\times$ DiT speedup and 45\% lower peak memory, enabling spatially untiled 4K VSR on a single 24GB RTX 4090. On the training side, we propose Reward-Yield Distribution Matching Distillation (Ry-DMD) for preference-aligned one-step generation. translated_abstract: 近期的视频超分辨率（VSR）模型通过扩散蒸馏实现了高效的单步生成。然而，高分辨率推理仍然成本高昂，且蒸馏后的模型难以与人类偏好对齐。这些挑战需要对模型架构和训练策略同时加以改进。我们提出 FlashVSR+ 来解决这两方面的局限。在架构方面，基于在预训练 VSR 模型中观察到的强局部性，我们引入了混合注意力机制，同时保留稀疏的全局交互以保证长程一致性。该方法实现了高达 2 倍的 DiT 加速，并将峰值显存降低 45%，使得在单张 24GB RTX 4090 上即可进行空间上不分块的 4K 视频超分辨率。在训练方面，我们提出了奖励-产量分布匹配蒸馏（Ry-DMD），用于实现偏好对齐的单步生成。Ry-DMD 利用奖励加权的教师 rollout 将黑盒奖励融入分布匹配，而无需……
tldr: FlashVSR+ 通过混合注意力架构实现 2 倍加速与 45% 显存降低、支持单卡无分块 4K 视频超分辨率，并借助奖励-产量分布匹配蒸馏（Ry-DMD）使单步生成结果与人类偏好对齐。
en_tdlr: FlashVSR+ enables efficient one-step video super-resolution via hybrid attention (2× DiT speedup, 45% lower peak memory, untiled 4K on a single 24GB GPU) and aligns outputs with human preferences through Reward-Yield Distribution Matching Distillation (Ry-DMD).
